name: Arithmetization of Inequality
description: Replaces the explicit logical implications ("If s_u = 1, then s_v = 2") with a simple arithmetic equation (s_u + s_v = 3) over the restricted domain {1, 2}. This avoids graph-coloring keywords like "different" or "opposite", forcing the model to algebraically deduce the bipartite nature of the constraints while maintaining a completely natural operational setting.
